name: Chrono-Telemetry Stream
author: Antigravity CTF Team
description: Doctor Doom's quantum-temporal displacement engine communicates telemetry with orbital satellites using the custom binary protocol CHRONO-STREAM/3.1 over TCP port 8043. Disarming the core requires issuing command 0x1337 (CHRONO_DRAIN_CORE) with an active 16-byte session token. Reverse engineer the protocol, exploit the zero-copy buffer reflection flaw in the diagnostics engine to leak the secret token, and drain the reactor.
